instruction: Candid studio portrait, medium close-up. Against a plain light grey background, three women are huddled in a warm embrace. On the left, the straight-haired woman (R1) in a white strap top smiles gently at the camera. In the center, the freckled woman with an afro (R3) in a light blue top smiles warmly, her hand resting on R1's shoulder. On the right, the curly-haired woman (R2) in a dark strap top leans her head close, smiling softly. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused studio lighting, creating a calm and affectionate atmosphere.
elements: R3 rests her hand on R1's shoulder
R1 receives the shoulder touch from R3
R2 leans her head close to the others
R3 is positioned in the central contact role of the huddle

questions.element: R1 is the recipient of R3's shoulder contact

questions.element: R2 performs the head-leaning contact role
